verdict.rationale: Daytona exposes a documented OpenAPI spec, Python/TypeScript SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP server, all explicitly aimed at programmatic sandbox control by AI agents, with code examples (e.g., daytona.create(), sandbox.process.exec). This directly satisfies API-driven, agentic usage; missing for 10: independent third-party validation of API completeness/versioning stability beyond vendor docs.
